description: Paid version of get_quote_free: the same indicative price from the same inputs, for $0.01 per call via x402 (USDC on Base, eip155:8453). Prefer get_quote_free, which is free and also returns booking details. Use this tool only when get_quote_free returns its rate-limit error (30 free quotes per hour per IP) or your agent is set up to pay per call. It has no contact fields and never creates a lead; to reach the movers use get_quote_free with contact details, or request_booking. Required: from_zip, to_zip, move_date (e.g. "20850", "60601", "2026-11-14"); size the move with cubic_feet, inventory, home_size or bedrooms. Input is checked before payment and invalid input is not charged. The first call returns an x402 payment requirement; retry with the payment in _meta["x402/payment"]. Returns quote_id, move_type (long_distance, local, or local_not_offered for short moves outside DC/MD/VA), indicative_total in USD, a line-item breakdown and the survey handoff. Indicative price per tariff, not a legal estimate.

bedrooms.description: Number of bedrooms (0-10), e.g. 2; use instead of home_size

cubic_feet.description: Total shipment cubic feet if known, e.g. 900. Takes priority over inventory, home_size and bedrooms for long distance (350 cf minimum billed)

est_hours.description: Local only: estimated labor hours (3-hour minimum)

extra_stops.description: Extra pickup or delivery stops, $150 each

guaranteed_delivery.description: Guaranteed delivery date, 42% of line haul (long distance)

home_size.description: Home size: studio, 1br, 2br, 3br, 4br or 5br+. The easiest way to size the move; used to estimate cubic feet (long distance) or crew and hours (local). Ignored for long distance when cubic_feet or a sized inventory is given

inventory.description: Optional item list, e.g. [{"name":"sofa","quantity":1,"cubic_feet":50}]. Give cubic_feet or weight_lbs per item (weight converted at 6.5 lb/cf); used instead of home_size when at least one item has a size

cubic_feet.description: Size of one item in cubic feet

weight_lbs.description: Weight of one item in pounds

long_carry_feet.description: Long carry distance in feet, $100 per 75 ft

packing.description: "full" adds full packing at $1.25 per cf (long distance); "none" or omitted means no packing. Partial packing is priced at the survey

shuttle.description: Shuttle truck needed, $1.25 per cf, $700 minimum

specialty_items.description: Bulky items with a flat handling fee, e.g. ["piano_upright"]. Allowed: piano_upright, piano_grand, piano_baby_grand, motorcycle, atv, pool_table, jacuzzi, appliance, aquarium, misc_bulky

storage_months.description: Months of storage, $50 per 100 cf per month

to_zip.description: Delivery 5-digit US ZIP in any US state, e.g. "32801". Over about 50 road miles is priced as long distance per cubic foot; shorter moves are priced hourly only when both ZIPs are in DC/MD/VA

unpacking.description: Full unpacking at $1.25 per cf (long distance)

name: get_quote
title: Moving quote (paid, $0.01)
